mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 0.39% is at a historically low level, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return after 2016-08-15 is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL above 240 signals persistent inflation, which increases real interest rates and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive when CPIAUCSL > 240.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS > 144000) and industrial production (INDPRO > 100) signals a robust economy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative when PAYEMS > 144000 AND INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime (UNRATE < 5%), strong employment conditions support positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative when UNRATE < 5.

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST above 1200 signals strong housing market activity, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative when HOUST > 1200.

mechanism_narrative: A INDPRO above 100 signals strong industrial production, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative when INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: A RSAFS above 450000 signals strong consumer spending, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative when RSAFS > 450000.

mechanism_narrative: A FEDFUNDS above 0.5% signals a monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive when FEDFUNDS > 0.5.
